description: This file defines models and logic for managing timesheets, attendance, and related reports in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including custom views, constraints, and business rules.

classes.name: one2many_mod2
classes.description: Custom one2many relation with date filtering based on current user and date.

classes.name: one2many_mod
classes.description: Custom one2many relation with date filtering based on current user and date.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_sheet
classes.description: Main timesheet sheet model with methods for validation, navigation, and state management.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_line
classes.description: Analytic timesheet extension with additional logic for sheet association and validation.

classes.name: hr_attendance
classes.description: Attendance model extension with sheet linkage and validation.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_sheet_sheet_day
classes.description: View model for timesheets summarized by period.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_sheet_sheet_account
classes.description: View model for timesheets summarized by analytic account.

classes.name: res_company
classes.description: Extension of company settings for timesheet range and maximum allowed difference.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve related records for one2many relation filtered by current user and date.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Set related records for one2many relation with context passing.

methods.name: _total_day
methods.description: Compute total attendance, timesheet, and their difference for sheets.

methods.name: _total
methods.description: Compute total attendance and timesheet for sheets.

methods.name: _state_attendance
methods.description: Determine attendance state for a timesheet based on employee data.

methods.name: check_employee_attendance_state
methods.description: Validate that sign-in and sign-out counts are equal for a timesheet.

methods.name: button_confirm
methods.description: Validate and confirm a timesheet, checking total difference constraints.

methods.name: date_today
methods.description: Set current date to today or boundary dates.

methods.name: date_previous
methods.description: Navigate to previous date in timesheet range.

methods.name: date_next
methods.description: Navigate to next date in timesheet range.

methods.name: button_dummy
methods.description: Reset current date to boundary dates.

methods.name: sign_in
methods.description: Record sign-in for employee, restricted to current date.

methods.name: sign_out
methods.description: Record sign-out for employee, restricted to current date.

methods.name: _get_default_date
methods.description: Default date for timesheet lines and attendance based on context or current time.

methods.name: _sheet
methods.description: Determine associated timesheet for a line based on date and user.

methods.name: _sheet_search
methods.description: Search for timesheets matching criteria for lines.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Validate that timesheet entries are modifiable based on sheet state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Create database views for timesheet summaries by day and account.
